title: Backsliding daughter!!! #iuicphilly #bible #repentance #salvation #iuic
segments: Verse 22, how long wil thou go about, oh
thou backsliding daughter? So the
backsliding daughter is the daughters of
Zion. When you read in Isaiah, it tells
you that the woman became real haughty.
Why? Because weak men began to puff up
their wives, puff up their children.
Don't want to correct the women in the
congregations, the the nation, the
communities. So the women begin to
backslide. Read on. For the Lord hath
created a new thing in the earth. A
what? A new thing in the earth. Read on.
A woman shall compass a man. Why is it a
new thing? Because the man in every
single society has always gotten honor
above the woman. Every single society.
But it's a new thing now where every
single thing is focused on the woman.
No.
